text:
elaine: Quick check — we need to lock agenda + steward for next crossfunc sync (RFC reviews, design triage). Proposed Tue 9:00am PT / 5:00pm UTC, 45m. Can folks volunteer to steward? Please add agenda items here: https://redwood.app/notes/crossfunc-rfc (pre-reads by EOD Fri).

jon: i'm blocked at that time. Can we do Wed 8am PT (4pm UTC)? shorter ok for me — 30m if no deep dives.

sarah: preference for Tue — we need to resolve rollout vs billing priorities before EOW. I'll add backlog items: #PLAT-482, #BILL-311

maddie: +1 on steward rotation. happy to steward if we stick to 45m. Agenda item: design review for model routing perf (PR: github.com/redwood/routing/pull/112).

sriram: I can steward this round. propose steward checklist:
```
- confirm pre-reads posted
- allocate 20m for RFC review, 15m for triage
- capture decisions in decision-log
- assign follow-ups in tracker
```

elaine: thanks @sriram — can you create the calendar and add the doc as attachment? also set Google Meet and record.

dev-bot: Calendar event created: Crossfunc Sync — Tue 09:00 PT / 45m — attendees: elaine, jon, sriram, maddie, sarah. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 :white_check_mark:

jon: if calendar is Tue but folks prefer Wed we can A/B — can we poll availability quickly? I'll post Doodle.

maddie: 👍 to poll. Also request: include a short pre-read summary in the doc so folks can skim.

elaine: poll posted: https://doodle.com/poll/xyz — please pick by EOD today. If majority picks Wed we'll move. If tied, steward decides. :calendar:

sarah: adding decision note: if rollout priority wins, we'll reserve first 15m for that.

sriram: noted. I'll draft steward notes template and drop in doc now.
